correctness.rationale: The Kraus completeness relation, branch probabilities and branch states are exact. The postmeasurement average is \(1/4\). The input entropy product is strictly below \(1/4\) because \(2^{19}<7^7\) implies \(\log_2 7>19/7\), so \(h_2(1/8)<5/8\) and \(h_2(1/8)^3<125/512<1/4\). The bundled verifier replays these exact identities and comparisons; its floating-point line is diagnostic only.

value.rationale: The finding is a direct exact failure of a defining entanglement-monotone requirement for a published three-qubit quantifier.
